articles.title: Cardano’s TapTools to wind down after 5 execs exit
articles.snippet: Despite the planned wind-down, TapTools says it is open to being acquired or taking on external resources to continue maintaining the platform.

articles.title: Perplexity Wants Your Laptop to Do Part of the AI Work—So It Doesn't Have To
articles.snippet: The company's new hybrid inference system routes AI tasks between your device and the cloud automatically. Privacy and cost savings are the pitch—and lower server bills.
